rationale: No self-replication; human boilermakers and coal-miners required for every aspect of operation and maintenance.
Early grids hand-operated; turbines and lines built by skilled labour; coal mined and supplied by human institutions.
Automated load balancing and protective relays; substantial human ops still required; substrate (turbines/copper/coal) entirely human-sourced.
Automated grid management at scale; some self-healing; substrate (silicon/copper/uranium) still human-sourced.
Packet routing autonomous; servers replaced and configured by humans; physical fibre and chip substrate all human-made.
Routing and CDN orchestration largely autonomous; some self-healing; physical substrate still entirely human.
Self-replicating from environmental resources; manufactures own machinery from amino acids and lipids it synthesises.
Self-replicating via swarms; constructs and maintains own substrate (comb); dependent on flower nectar (analogous to environmental energy not constructed by another agent).
High operational autonomy; substrate (sensors/actuators/chips) entirely human-built and human-maintained.
Current AI; v3 framework primary case.
